description: Figure 2 presents a bar chart illustrating the accuracy scores of different models across paraphrase sentiment and STS tasks. The horizontal axis displays the model names—Star Allliance, BERT, All-mpnet-base-v2, and paraphrase—listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  Four bars are present, one for each model. The “All-mpnet-base-v2” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 88%. The “BERT” bar is dark blue and reaches approximately 78%. The “paraphrase” bar is a shade of green and reaches approximately 72%. Finally, the “Star Allliance” bar is orange and extends to approximately 67%. The bars are not visually emphasized with any shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
